content_summary: Created an in-depth article about PACKET_MMAP and TPACKET_V3 ring buffers. Explained the performance bottleneck of recvfrom(), the evolution from TPACKET_V1 to TPACKET_V3, provided C code examples for initialization and reading, discussed fanout, and mentioned AF_XDP. Added a Python script to render SVG diagrams for architecture and block structure.
